desc:
Get ready to experience an incredible voyage across the Metaverse as we celebrate the best Roblox creators and experiences of 2020. Featuring special appearances by Rovi23, KreekCraft, TanqR, iamSanna, and LeahAshe.

The Bloxys experience will play at the top of every other hour.

🚀 Journey across the Roblox Metaverse with your friends
🏆 See which creators and experiences won this year’s top awards
🍿 Dress your avatar in limited-edition Bloxys souvenirs
🔍 Search for the missing scavenger hunt items in the lobby to earn an exclusive item

WARNING:
This video contains flashing lights and may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy.
Viewer discretion is advised.

#BloxyAwards
